videos.name: Surinder Kaur Ji
videos.where: Home renovation and Aman Chicken, BRS Nagar, Ludhiana
videos.quote: They have a very good collection. They gave us a very good deal.
videos.original: Hello, Sat Sri Akal ji. Mera naam Surinder Kaur hai. Assi ghar di renovation karwa rahe si. Assi Drambay Tiles te gaye. Ohna di bohot hi achhi collection hai. Bohot hi vadiya ohna ne deal kita, bohot achhe retta'n te. Main kehni aa tussi vi ik vaar othe visit karo te zaroor otho lai ke aao. Jo lod da saman hai sab ohna kol hai te saanu sab kuch otho hi milya. Jo assi ghar vi lagwaya te Aman Chicken te vi lagwaya.
videos.english: Hello, Sat Sri Akal. My name is Surinder Kaur. We were getting our house renovated and went to Drambay Tiles. They have a very good collection. They gave us a very good deal, at very good rates. I'd say visit them once and do buy from there. Everything we needed, they had, and we got it all from there. We used it at our home and at Aman Chicken too.

videos.name: Deepak Ji
videos.where: Helpful NGO Welfare Society free dialysis centre, Ludhiana
videos.quote: Look how it shines. Wipe it with a cloth and the tile is clean.
videos.original: Helpful NGO Welfare Society, Nar Sewa Narayan Sewa, free dialysis center mere dosto. Aaj hum Drambay Tile ke baare mein bata rahe hain, jaise lagi hui hai dekho. 25 mahine dialysis center ko ho gaye. Humare har jagah Drambay Tile lagi hui hai. Ab main aapko inki quality dikha raha hoon. Dekho kitni chamak hai yeh. Kapda maaro, tile saaf. Aur mujhe poori umeed hai jaise humne dialysis center mein, ek aspatal mein Drambay Tile lagayi, aap apne gharon mein, officon mein, har jagah yeh tile lagayenge.
videos.english: Helpful NGO Welfare Society, free dialysis centre, my friends. Today we're talking about Drambay Tile, as you can see it here. The dialysis centre has run for 25 months, and Drambay Tile is fitted everywhere. Let me show you the quality. Look how it shines. Wipe it with a cloth and the tile is clean. Just as we fitted Drambay Tile in a dialysis centre, a hospital, I'm sure you'll fit it in your homes and offices too.
